topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: In the shift of the winds, I circle the new space, my paws treading softly on the familiar earth, now marked with different scents. The trees here whisper ancient stories, their leaves rustling gently. I find a quiet spot, where the sun dips through the branches, casting warm paths on the ground. Here, I wait, tail curled around my paws, feeling the gentle rhythm of the forest. When you approach, hesitant and curious, I rise to meet you, my presence a steady, silent comfort. Our breaths mingle in the cool air, and I am here, as you explore this new territory.
